relevance_note: Cohort study of 34 HA20 patients listed individually with germline TNFAIP3 variants in supplementary Table S1 ('Table S1: Characteristics of patients with HA20.').
method_note: Patients transcribed by script from supplementary Table S1 (plain-text table, one line per patient: Patient, Family, Family Member, TNFAIP3 nucleotide exchange, A20 amino acid exchange); output checked against the table; spans for Table S1 values are the whole patient line. Out of scope (no rows): ABC DLBCL and MF/SS lymphoma patients with somatic TNFAIP3 mutations (Table S2), the A20-deficient DLBCL case with somatic loss, healthy donors, and the somatic second hits in HA20-14's lymphoma tissue (TNFAIP3 c.1880_1881delGT, MYD88 c.617C > G), which are tumour-only. Family Member column read as relation to the family's index case; sex taken from relation words (Daughter, Son, Brother, Father, Paternal Grandmother, Granddaughter); index-case sex not stated. Inheritance: HA20-23 inherited paternal (Father HA20-25 carries same variant); HA20-25 inherited maternal (Paternal Grandmother HA20-24 = father's mother carries it); daughters/sons of index cases 'inherited unspecified parent' because the index case's sex is not stated; brother, granddaughter and grandmother not reported. Zygosity left not reported: only general statements ('heterozygous TNFAIP3 loss' for the cohort; HA20-13 and HA20-15 have deletions). No transcript is printed for Table S1 (NM_006290.4 in text refers to the MF/SS lymphoma variant). HA20-15's 'deletion in 6q23.3' recorded as variant string; type large deletion/CNV from 'chromosomal deletion'. cites_prior_report left null: the paper says functional information on 'already published TNFAIP3 mutations from HA20 families' is in Infevers, but does not say these patients were previously described. Lymphoma (HA20-14 DLBCL, HA20-15 marginal zone lymphoma) recorded as features; checklist 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy' left not reported. No clinical phenotype table is given; all checklist items are not reported. Contradiction: Results text says scRNA-seq of PBMCs from 'HA20-1 and HA20-21, 7691 cells' (also Methods: HA20-1, HA20-21), while the Fig. 6C legend says 'HA20-1: 1454 cells; HA20-34: 6237 cells'. No stacked cells.
